newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha eases in line with lower crude prices.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha eases in line with lower crude prices.

text.p: NWE naphtha headed lower on Tuesday in line with falling crude prices and lacklustre physical demand, traders said.
"There are a few cargoes and not many takers," said one trader.
At least three cargoes were reported to be on offer in Northwest Europe with traders assessing bids and offers around the $194/$198 level.
"Nothing's really changed. It's pretty quiet," said one trader.
Naphtha swaps slipped back into contango with March swaps talked at $197.50 cif NWE and April swaps talked at $198.50 cif NWE.

Traders said the supply situation in the Mediterranean appeared to be easing. Some players had suggested that tight supply in the region due to strong demand from the East would lend support to the NWE market.
